title: Espresso Upgrade Spiral Arcade
oneLiner: A playful hobby-spend simulator that shows coffee gear buyers the exact moment a tiny fix becomes a $5K identity quest.
signals: S10 Reddit r/espresso: gasket fix becomes endgame upgrade thread
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive playful web experience called "Espresso Upgrade Spiral Arcade" for home coffee hobbyists. Build an interactive upgrade simulator where a small coffee problem branches into repair, grinder-first, sensible machine, and premium endgame paths, with joy-per-dollar, regret risk, household constraints, community advice cards, and a shareable final receipt poster. Required sections: starting itch selector, upgrade ladder, reality cards, joy-per-dollar gauge, regret-risk meter, community quote carousel, final receipt poster, and cheapest-fix reset. Design direction: use the `playful-experimental` profile with bold cafe-inspired contrast, lively but readable interaction states, arcade-like progression, and a memorable portfolio-worthy first screen.
